entities.summary: Olivier Richters is a Dutch professional bodybuilder and actor. Known as The Dutch Giant, Richters stands at 2.18 metres tall. After pursuing a career in bodybuilding, Richters focused more intentionally on his acting career, portraying characters such as Ursa in the 2021 film Black Widow. He also appeared in The King's Man and The Electrical Life of Louis Wain in 2021, in Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny in 2023, and the third season of Reacher in 2025.
